venues.name: Baratang, the limestone caves
venues.note: A dawn convoy along the Andaman Trunk Road, then a speedboat through primeval mangrove creeks and a short forest walk to caves hung with stalactites and stalagmites, a proper adventure day out of Port Blair. The road crosses the protected Jarawa reserve in escorted convoy, where stopping, photography and any contact are strictly forbidden, and rightly so.

venues.name: Baratang, the mud volcanoes
venues.note: Small, bubbling cones of grey mud pushed up by natural gas, a rare geological curiosity and the other half of the classic Baratang day. Modest to look at but genuinely unusual, and a hit with children collecting oddities of nature.
